name: How do I know if my water softener needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my water softener needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your water softener needs replacement include scale buildup returning on fixtures and appliances, a noticeable change in water taste or feel, decreased water pressure, or the unit running constantly without softening. An older unit, typically over 10-15 years, showing these symptoms often indicates it's time for a professional assessment. Our technicians can perform diagnostic checks to confirm if repair or replacement is the most cost-effective solution for your home in the Las Vegas area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for scale buildup, changes in water taste/feel, or decreased water pressure. An older unit exhibiting these signs usually needs professional evaluation.
